fonts.display: 'TWK Everett', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Switzer', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Ember Orange
palette.role: Orange action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

palette.name: Void Black
palette.role: Page canvas, hero background, card surface base, footer — the dominant stage on which everything floats

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated.

palette.name: Graphite Border
palette.role: Hairline dividers, ghost button borders, section separators — barely-there structural lines

palette.name: Steel Mid
palette.role: Secondary metadata, timestamps, muted labels, tertiary body copy

palette.name: Fog Light
palette.role: Card borders on dark surfaces, secondary text, dimmed paragraph copy — a lighter neutral for readability without full white

palette.name: Bone White
palette.role: Primary text, headlines, nav items, icon strokes, ghost button borders — the luminous text color across all dark surfaces
